_README: NOT A REAL SARVAM RESPONSE. Hand-authored stand-in used only when
SARVAM_OFFLINE=1 and no real cached response exists for the page.
It exists because M0 could not make a live call: no SARVAM_API_KEY.
Each entry models what Doc-Intelligence would plausibly return for one of
our demo pages, INCLUDING its failures: the tehsil stamp eats the area
column on rows 2-3 of the register page, and the struck-through owner
correction surfaces as two competing names. Deliberately carries NO
per-region confidence numbers, because nothing in the Sarvam docs promises
any -- extraction/confidence.py has to earn the number from evidence.
The four entries use four DIFFERENT container shapes on purpose
(pages[].text, pages[].markdown, a bare string, a flat {text}) so the
normaliser in extraction/pipeline.py is exercised against every shape the
undocumented result file might actually take.
The moment a key lands, one real call writes
fixtures/raw/<stem>.docintel.json and that takes precedence over this file.

तहसील कार्यालय — फेरफार (म्यूटेशन) आवेदन चेकलिस्ट

1. मृत्यु प्रमाण पत्र की प्रति आवश्यक है / Death certificate of the recorded owner is required.
2. वारसाहक्क प्रमाणपत्र अथवा नोटरीकृत शपथपत्र आवश्यक है / Heirship certificate or a notarised affidavit is required.
3. Name of applicant must match the record-of-rights entry exactly.
4. आवेदन दिनांक 14/08/2026 तक तलाठी कार्यालय में जमा करें / Submit the application to the Talathi office by 14/08/2026.
5. प्रक्रिया अवधि: 25 दिन।
